verdict.rationale: Sentry's official getsentry/sentry-api-schema GitHub repository publishes a downloadable, dereferenced OpenAPI 3.0.3 document for the Sentry Public API covering the full /api/0/ surface. The probe's 404s on docs.sentry.io candidate paths only show the spec isn't served from the docs domain; they don't contradict the GitHub-hosted spec. Missing for 10: discoverability from the docs site (standard openapi.json/.well-known paths return 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of the spec's completeness and accuracy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: The official getsentry/sentry-api-schema repository publishes the dereferenced OpenAPI 3.0.3 document for the "Sentry Public API" (info title "API Reference", version v0), covering the full /api/0/ surface.
The Sentry web API is used to access the Sentry platform programmatically.
